name: Avaland Berhad
overview: 2026年，Avaland Berhad 通过多家全资子公司完成多宗土地收购，包括以 RM86,039,000 收购 Kuala Lumpur 约 7,612.63 平方米永久地契发展地、以 RM148.8 million 收购 Bandar Kuala Lumpur 约 3.194 英亩永久地契发展地，以及以 RM49.0 million 收购 Bandar Petaling Jaya 约 2.172 英亩租赁地契发展地，用于物业发展。年内未公告新业务线、业务出售或缩减。
overview_en: In 2026, Avaland Berhad, through wholly-owned subsidiaries, completed several land acquisitions, including approximately 7,612.63 square metres of freehold development land in Kuala Lumpur for RM86,039,000, approximately 3.194 acres of freehold development land in Bandar Kuala Lumpur for RM148.8 million, and approximately 2.172 acres of leasehold development land in Bandar Petaling Jaya for RM49.0 million, for property development.

segments.name: 物业发展
segments.note: 今年完成多宗土地收购，扩大在 Kuala Lumpur 和 Bandar Petaling Jaya 的发展土地储备。
segments.note_en: Completed several land acquisitions this year, expanding development land bank in Kuala Lumpur and Bandar Petaling Jaya.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Leisure Event Sdn. Bhd. 以 RM49.0 million 收购 Bandar Petaling Jaya 约 2.172 英亩租赁地契发展地，买卖协议于2025年10月30日成为无条件。
actions.text_en: Leisure Event Sdn. Bhd. acquired approximately 2.172 acres of leasehold development land in Bandar Petaling Jaya for RM49.0 million, with the sale and purchase agreement becoming unconditional on 30 October 2025.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Nexus Advertising Sdn. Bhd. 于2026年9月2日获律师确认上述土地收购的买卖协议所有先决条件已达成。
actions.text_en: Nexus Advertising Sdn. Bhd. received confirmation from its solicitors on 2 September 2026 that all conditions precedent to the sale and purchase agreement for the above land acquisition had been fulfilled.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Nexus Advertising Sdn. Bhd. 于2026年4月28日与 Tong Ah Company Sdn. Berhad 签订有条件买卖协议，以 RM86,039,000 收购 Kuala Lumpur 约 7,612.63 平方米永久地契发展地。
actions.text_en: Nexus Advertising Sdn. Bhd. entered into a conditional sale and purchase agreement on 28 April 2026 with Tong Ah Company Sdn. Berhad to acquire approximately 7,612.63 square metres of freehold development land in Kuala Lumpur for RM86,039,000.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Solid Interest Sdn. Bhd. 于2026年3月24日付清上述土地收购的买卖协议余额。
actions.text_en: Solid Interest Sdn. Bhd. fully paid the balance purchase price under the sale and purchase agreement for the above land acquisition on 24 March 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Leisure Event Sdn. Bhd. 于2026年1月16日付清上述土地收购的买卖协议余额。
actions.text_en: Leisure Event Sdn. Bhd. fully paid the balance purchase price under the sale and purchase agreement for the above land acquisition on 16 January 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Solid Interest Sdn. Bhd. 以 RM148.8 million 收购 Bandar Kuala Lumpur 约 3.194 英亩九幅相邻永久地契发展地，买卖协议于2026年1月2日成为无条件。
actions.text_en: Solid Interest Sdn. Bhd. acquired nine adjoining parcels of freehold development land measuring approximately 3.194 acres in Bandar Kuala Lumpur for RM148.8 million, with the sale and purchase agreement becoming unconditional on 2 January 2026.
